Ana Chen: Morning team — quick snapshot from me (WIP):
- Yesterday: landed KV cache tuning and rolled to staging; reduced tail p99 by ~15%.
- Blockers: seeing intermittent checksum mismatch on quantized weights when sequence > 4k; reproducing locally.
- Today: dig into quant mismatch, open a hotfix PR if needed, pair with @Jon if I need infra traces.
PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/528

Jon Patel: Nice! I'll check traces and logs after standup. If it's a kernel mismatch we can try fallbacks.

Samir Khan: FYI I'm blocked on model card review — need final perf numbers from the runtime PR to finish docs.

Ana Chen: @Samir I can paste perf numbers later today. Samir — which format you need? csv/json?

Samir Khan: csv is easiest for the pipeline, but JSON ok too. thanks.

Maria Lopez: On security side, audit for KMS rotation is scheduled for Friday. No action needed this week unless you see key-exposed logs.

Ana Chen: noted, thanks @Maria.

Emma (deploy-bot): deploy: staging/runtime-v2.18 started by @ana — status: SUCCESS :white_check_mark:

Jon Patel: Quick ask — can reviewers look at PR 528 + 531? 528 is the cache change, 531 is tiny infra tweak.

Maria Lopez: @team reminder: please ack the SSO reconsent email by EOD so the migration doesn't lock folks out.

Samir Khan: Also tagging @Jon — can you unblock the EVAL queue? My scheduled runs are piling up.

Jon Patel: Yep, bumping priority on the eval workers. ETA ~30m.

Ana Chen: Thanks all. If anyone wants to pair on the quant bug ping me in DM. I'll post repro steps in the thread later.

Samir Khan: Adding repro note for later: reproduces with seq_len=8192 + kqkv.exe on ampere nodes.

Ana Chen: /me files a follow-up with logs and a small script.

Jon Patel: :thumbsup:
